content.short: Coinlink is a cross-chain DeFi aggregator for swaps, lending, borrowing, and yield services across ecosystems.
content.description: Coinlink is a cross-chain aggregation service designed to connect DeFi activity across Cardano, Ethereum, Polygon, and other networks. The project aims to bring swaps, lending, borrowing, and yield farming into one interface so users can find opportunities without manually moving between many protocols. Its Cardano focus is to make native liquidity and outside-chain liquidity easier to compare and access. Coinlink fits the DeFi tooling layer as an aggregator for users who want broader market access from a single product.
